items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The ancient deep crow makes three attacks: one with its mandibles and two with its claws.

items.name: Mandibles
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the ancient deep crow can't use its mandibles on another target.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

items.name: Shadow Caw
items.notes: Each creature within 60 feet of the crow and able to hear it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The ancient deep crow has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Shadow Stealth
items.notes: While in dim light or darkness, the ancient deep crow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

items.name: Detect
items.notes: The deep crow makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

items.name: Shadow Caw
items.notes: The ancient deep crow uses Shadow Caw.

items.name: Wing Attack
items.notes: The ancient deep crow beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the deep crow must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The ancient deep crow can then fly up to half its flying speed.

regional_effects.header:
The region containing an ancient deep crow's lair is transformed by the creature's presence, which creates one or more of the following effects:

If the ancient deep crow dies, these effects fade immediately.

items.name: Supernatural shadow
items.notes: Supernatural shadow turns all bright light to dim light in underground regions within 6 miles of the lair.

items.name: Intermittent, echoing caws
items.notes: Intermittent, echoing caws can be heard coming from all directions within 6 miles of the lair.

items.name: Subterranean beasts
items.notes: Subterranean beasts within 1 mile of the ancient deep crow's lair serve as the creature's eyes and ears, alerting it to the presence of intruders and making it all but impossible to surprise the ancient deep crow.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
spellcasting.notes: Auspicia's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence. She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Auspicia makes two attacks.

items.name: Longsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Brahma is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following bard spells prepared:

items.name: War Lute
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

items.name: Song of Domination
items.notes: Brahma targets one creature that can see or hear her, which must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. It has disadvantage on these saves if being charmed by Brahma is something the target openly or secretly desires. For 1 hour after the charm effect ends, the target has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma checks made as part of a contest with Brahma.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Brahma has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

items.name: Taunt
items.notes: Brahma can use a bonus action to target one creature she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can hear Brahma, it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of Brahma's next turn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The chaos quadrapod makes up to two tentacle attacks.

items.name: Tentacle
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The chaos quadrapod can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

items.name: Chaos Cloud
items.notes: The chaos quadrapod shoots forth a knot of roiling ethereal light that explodes at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The chaos quadrapod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Fire Breath
items.notes: The clockwork dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: While the clockwork dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a metal statue.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The deep crow makes three attacks: one with its mandibles and two with its claws.

items.name: Mandibles
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the deep crow can't use its mandibles on another target.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The deep crow has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Shadow Stealth
items.notes: While in dim light or darkness, the deep crow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the deep crow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Donaar is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following paladin spells prepared:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Donaar makes two attacks with his greatsword or his whip.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. Whenever Donaar rolls a 1 or 2 on a damage die, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

items.name: Whip
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Acid Vomit
items.notes: Donaar regurgitates acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Champion Challenge
items.notes: As a bonus action, Donaar causes each creature of his choice that he can see within 30 feet of him to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from Donaar. This effect ends on the creature if Donaar is incapacitated or dies, or if the creature is moved more than 30 feet away from him.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Minor Conjuration
items.notes: Jim conjures an inanimate object, no larger than 3 feet on a side and no more than 10 pounds, in his hand or on the ground in an unoccupied space he can see within 10 feet of him. The object is visibly magical, radiating dim light out to 5 feet. It disappears if it takes any damage, after 1 hour, or when Jim uses this feature again.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Jim carries a wand of wonder.

items.name: Benign Transportation
items.notes: As a bonus action, Jim teleports up to 30 feet to a space he can see. The space must be unoccupied or occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature. If the latter, Jim and the willing creature both teleport, swapping places.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: K'thriss makes two attacks with his sickle.

items.name: Sickle
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

items.name: Special Equipment

items.name: Awakened Mind
items.notes: K'thriss can telepathically speak to any creature he can see within 30 feet of him, provided the creature can understand at least one language.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: K'thriss has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep. Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, K'thriss has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

items.name: Fist
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Acid Squirt
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) acid damage.

items.name: Beer Shower
items.notes:
The keg robot spews an unnaturally potent beer in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a creature has its speed halved by exposure to the potent brew. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Additionally, the beer shower extinguishes any fires or open flames in its area.

items.name: Hot Oil Spray
items.notes:
The keg robot sprays hot oil in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (1d8 + 3) fire damage and falls prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone.

Any creature affected by the hot oil spray that takes fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute) takes an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage, and the oil burns away.

If the oil that remains in the area of the spray is lit, it burns for 1d4 rounds and deals 3 (1d6) fire damage to any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

items.name: Customizable Storage
items.notes: A keg robot can hold up to three types of liquid payload totaling 12 gallons within its hollow, barrel-shaped body. A full keg robot can make one liquid attack per gallon before the liquid must be refilled. Filling a keg robot takes 2 rounds per gallon. Differing payloads can alter the keg robot's attacks from those presented here.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Return the Favor
items.notes: When Oak takes damage from a melee weapon attack, he can make a hooked dagger attack.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Oak has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

items.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
items.notes: Oak has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Omin is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Omin makes two attacks with his maul.

items.name: Maul
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: War God's Blessing
items.notes: When a creature within 30 feet of Omin makes an attack roll, but before learning whether it hits or misses, Omin can grant the creature a +10 bonus to that roll.

items.name: Divine Strike
items.notes: Once on each of his turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, Omin can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage of the same type dealt by the weapon.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Omin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Pendragon is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Echo Spell
items.notes: Pendragon can cast the spell he cast on his last turn, whose casting time becomes 1 bonus action. This bonus casting uses a spell slot as normal.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Phoenix is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Phoenix makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Warhammer
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet.

items.name: Divine Display
items.notes: As a bonus action, Phoenix causes his shield to flare with divine light. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Portentia makes three melee attacks.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes: Portentia magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than her own, or back into her true form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (her choice). In a new form, Portentia retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.notes: Portentia deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Portentia that isn't incapacitated and Portentia doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Prophetess is a 5th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Prophetess has the following cleric spells prepared:

items.name: Maul
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Divine Eminence
items.notes: As a bonus action, Prophetess can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Prophetess expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Prophetess has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Rosie's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Rosie makes three attacks, then makes two unarmed strike attacks.

items.name: Staff of the Master (+1 Quarterstaff)
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

items.name: Unarmed Strike
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Rosie's unarmed strikes are magical.

items.name: Deflect Missiles
items.notes: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Rosie deflects the missile. The damage she takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 9. If the damage is reduced to 0, she catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and she has a hand free.

items.name: Brave
items.notes: Rosie has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

items.name: Halfling Nimbleness
items.notes: Rosie can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than hers.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: If Rosie is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she's incapacitated.

items.name: Shadow Step
items.notes: When Rosie is in dim light or darkness, she can use a bonus action to teleport 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see that is also in dim light or darkness. She then has advantage on the first melee attack she makes before the end of the turn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Splugoth makes two attacks with his dagger.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

items.name: Word From Beyond
items.notes: Splugoth remembers and repeats aloud a few words from a place he entered while walking back from the next world to this one. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet of him that can hear him must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Absorb Attack
items.notes: When a creature Splugoth can see hits him with a melee weapon attack, the weapon snags on a pocket of residual resurrectional energy and is caught fast. The attack is negated and the weapon cannot be used until the creature succeeds on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to pull it out of Splugoth. Natural weapons can have their attacks negated by this feature, but can then be retracted automatically at the end of the attacking creature's turn.

items.name: Defensive Advantage
items.notes: As long as two or more of Splugoth's allies are within 5 feet of him and are not incapacitated, attack rolls against him are made with disadvantage.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: Splugoth can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

items.name: Touch of Madness
items.notes: Splugoth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Viari makes two attacks with his shortsword and two attacks with his rapier.

items.name: +1 Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

items.name: Rapier
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: Viari halves the damage that he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: If Viari is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails. He can't use this trait if he's incapacitated.

items.name: Second-Story Work
items.notes: Climbing does not cost Viari extra movement. Additionally, when he makes a running jump, the distance he covers increases by 5 feet.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.notes: Viari deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Viari that isn't incapacitated and Viari doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

spellcasting.notes: Walnut is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Walnut makes two attacks with Foremother or her longbow.

items.name: Foremother
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

items.name: Longbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Walnut has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

items.name: Mask of the Wild
items.notes: Walnut can attempt to hide even when she is only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

items.name: Wild Shape
items.notes:
As a bonus action, Walnut can assume the shape of a dire wolf. She can stay in this form for 3 hours or until she reverts to her normal form as a bonus action. She automatically reverts if she falls unconscious, drops to 0 hit points, or dies.

While transformed, Walnut's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the dire wolf, except she retains her alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

Her attacks in beast form are magical. While in beast form, Walnut can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot and regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.
